item.title: KKR Completes Acquisition Of Cheongna Logistics Center In South Korea
item.description: KKR has completed the acquisition of Cheongna Logistics Center, a large-scale logistics facility in Incheon, South Korea, through a fund managed locally by its affiliated Korean asset manager, Kreate Asset Management (Kreate). KKR said the deal represents the largest single-asset logistics transaction in South Korea to date, underscoring sustained institutional demand for modern, high-specification warehouse space tied to the country’s e-commerce-led logistics growth. item.title: SoftBank Group to Acquire DigitalBridge for $4 Billion to Scale Next-Gen AI Infrastructure
item.description: SoftBank Group has signed a definitive agreement to acquire DigitalBridge Group, a global alternative asset manager focused on digital infrastructure, in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $4.0 billion in enterprise value. The deal is intended to expand SoftBank’s capacity across data centers and connectivity assets as the company positions itself to support large-scale AI training, deployment, and delivery worldwide. item.title: Brivo And Eagle Eye Networks Merge To Form AI Cloud-Native Physical Security Company
item.description: Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks said they will merge to create what they describe as the world’s largest AI cloud-native physical security company, combining cloud access control and smart space technology with cloud AI video surveillance under a single, unified platform. The merged company will operate under the Brivo name and aim to simplify how enterprises deploy and manage physical security by consolidating capabilities and support into one integrated offering.
